description.value: Jasmine Garden Seafood Restaurant is a family-owned Chinese restaurant in West Abbotsford, in business since June 2000, serving authentic Cantonese and Szechuan cuisine. The full-service dine-in restaurant also offers takeout and local delivery, with a broad menu spanning dim-sum-style appetizers, seafood, noodles, and family dinner combos. A dedicated gluten-free menu section makes it a practical stop for cyclists with dietary restrictions.

address.value: #1 - 31813 South Fraser Way, Abbotsford, BC V2T 1V4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at jasmine-garden.ca is active and fully corroborates OSM contact details (phone, address, website). Takeout and delivery are explicitly advertised on the front page ('DINE IN, TAKE OUT OR DELIVERY'), and a dedicated Gluten Free menu page confirms GF options. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. The OSM 'community' field says 'Chilliwack' but both the website and postal code V2T 1V4 clearly place this business in Abbotsford.
concerns: OSM 'community' field lists 'Chilliwack' but the business is in Abbotsford, BC per its own website and postal code V2T 1V4 — the community tag appears to be incorrect.
OSM 'official_name' tag is 'Jasmine Garden Chinese Restaurant' while the trading name used consistently on the website is 'Jasmine Garden Seafood Restaurant'.

The About Us page contains unfilled Lorem ipsum placeholder text and fictional staff names (John Smith, Jane Madison, etc.), suggesting the website template was never fully completed, though core contact and menu content appears genuine and current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, long-established full-service restaurant with confirmed takeout and gluten-free options; a useful food and rest stop for touring cyclists on South Fraser Way in Abbotsford.

Takeout.detail: Website front page: 'DINE IN, TAKE OUT OR DELIVERY — FOR PICK UP OR DELIVERY CALL US NOW 604-850-8628'; 10% off on pickup orders with $40 minimum

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated Gluten Free menu page lists fried rice, fu yung, chow mein, chop suey, and other dishes made gluten-free (chow mein with vermicelli). Vegetable-only dishes also appear throughout the main menu (Vegetable Chop Suey, Braised Bean Curd, Gai-Lan, etc.). Disclaimer notes GF dishes are prepared in a shared kitchen
